messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00}{04 1f 00}, do you
know anything about the
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}told me about it a
while back.{01 01 00} And according to
{ff 00 00 02}Ms. Nintendique{ff 00 00 00},
{07 13 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}bones
can also hydrate your skin!
{01 01 00}{07 00 00}Don't ask me how it works.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 14 00}{07 0b 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa
tead midagi
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} kohta?
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}rääkis mulle
sellest mõni aeg tagasi.{01 01 00} Ja {ff 00 00 02}
preili Nintendique{ff 00 00 00}i sõnul
{07 13 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}luud
niisutavad ka nahka!
{01 01 00}{07 00 00}Ära küsi, kuidas see toimib.

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Why is it{01 00 00 0a 00} that when I look
at a fossil, I feel so
comforted, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 19 00}Especially the
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 0a 00}I bet
it's 'cause it's so scary!{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}Yeah, it would totally scare
off intruders! {01 00 00 0a 00}One look at
it and they'd run away!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Miks on nii,{01 00 00 0a 00} et kui vaatan
fossiili, tunnen ma end nii
lohutatult, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 19 00}Eriti
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 0a 00}Kindlasti
sest see on nii hirmus!{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}Jah, see peletaks vargad
täiesti eemale! {01 00 00 0a 00}Üks pilk
ja nad jooksevad minema!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You know, {01 00 00 0a 00}I used to be a
big fossil collector, 
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I had lots of fossils, {07 14 00}but
the {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} 
{ff 00 00 00}was always my favorite.
{07 19 00}Yep, {01 00 00 05 00}those were the good
old days...{01 01 00} Maybe I should
go find it again.{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tead, {01 00 00 0a 00}ma olin kunagi
suur fossiilikoguja,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Mul oli palju fossiile, {07 14 00}aga
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}oli alati mu lemmik.
{07 19 00}Jah, {01 00 00 05 00}need olid head vanad
ajad...{01 01 00} Ehk peaksin
selle uuesti üles otsima.{07 00 00}
